When handling the end of an mmu_notifier invalidation
mn_active_invalidate_count is already 0 do not decrement it further
avoid causing mn_active_invalidate_count to underflow/wrap.  In the worst
end() calls are *supposed* to be paired with start()
only happen if there is a bug elsewhere in the kernel
lockdep assertions in the mmu_notifier helpers

column1: bug to go unnoticed for some time
mmu_notifiers aren't required to hold any one specific lock
the necessary annotations to make lockdep aware of all locks that are
mutally exclusive with mm_take_all_locks() isn't trivial.
